descriptions.descr-1: Heavy Engineering LLC is an engineering integrator specializing in sulfuric acid production technologies and other large-scale industrial processes.
descriptions.descr-2: Heavy Engineering LLC is a technology partner and distributor of the Russian sulfur dioxide oxidation catalyst manufacturer Samara Catalyst Plant JSC, as well as an official agent and distributor of Keyontechs Group (Keyon Process Co., LTD.).
descriptions.descr-3: Our customers include mineral fertilizer producers, non-ferrous metallurgy enterprises, and oil refining plants.
descriptions.descr-4: Our expertise is based on a team of qualified engineers, process specialists, and experts with many years of unique experience gained in leading international and Russian companies.

list.title: Key areas of our activity:
list.item1: design of process units in cooperation with leading global process licensors;
list.item3: supply and service of industrial catalysts.

card-1.title: Integrated Solutions
card-1.text: A full cycle of engineering services — from process development and design to equipment supply.

card-2.title: Advanced Technologies
card-2.text: Implementation of advanced technologies — from process adaptation to full-scale industrial operation.

card-3.title: Support Services
card-3.text: Comprehensive service support of equipment — from commissioning to ongoing technical assistance.

catalysts.title: CATALYSTS AND SERVICES
catalysts.description: Sulfur dioxide oxidation catalysts manufactured by Samara Catalyst Plant JSC. Catalyst screening, loading, and unloading services.

list.item1: Vanadium catalysts (LT) — optimal for low-temperature operating conditions.
list.item2: Vanadium catalysts (HT) — ensure stable operation under standard conditions.
list.item3: Cesium catalysts — for maximum activity and performance.

catalysts.note: We provide technical selection, supply, logistics, and implementation support for catalysts manufactured by Samara Catalyst Plant (SZK).

technologies.title: TECHNOLOGIES AND EQUIPMENT
technologies.description: Sulfuric acid production technologies DCDA and wet catalysis (WSA). Gas cleaning technologies (scrubbers, Dyna-Wave counter-current scrubbers, electrostatic precipitators). Phosphogypsum utilization technologies and phosphoric acid production processes. Ammonia production technologies (Casale supply scope). Sulfuric acid alkylation and spent acid regeneration technologies.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Contact us for consultations, catalyst selection, and commercial proposals. We are always open to cooperation and ready to answer any questions.
